about: Gems: unique power-ups (relics). One of a kind per run; bosses and deep chests offer a pick of 1 of 3. A hero's own gems live in its hero file.

entries.name: Ruby
entries.text: Your hits have a 12% chance to set foes burning for 3 s.

entries.name: Sapphire
entries.text: Your hits chill foes: 20% slower for 2 s.

entries.name: Emerald
entries.text: Each kill heals 3% of your life.

entries.name: Topaz
entries.text: A free dodge roll every 8 s that costs no stamina.

entries.name: Amethyst
entries.text: After a dodge roll, monsters lose sight of you for 1.5 s.

entries.name: Onyx
entries.text: A ward worth 12% of your life soaks blows and refills out of combat.

entries.name: Crown Diamond
entries.text: Boss only. Every 5th skill cast is free and deals double damage.
